install_configen_package: install the hydra-configen package using pip to generate Hydra config files from Python classes
run_configen_cli: run the configen CLI tool to generate Hydra configuration from a Python module
review_setup_config: review the setup.py configuration for the hydra-configen package including dependencies and entry points

refactor_entry_points: refactor the setup.py entry points to add or modify console script commands for configen
